Method of Attack: First-stage downloader module rewritten by Silence group for initial infection
Impacted Systems: Banks in former Soviet Union, Europe, Latin America, Africa, Asia
Financial institutions in Russia, UK, Chile, Bulgaria, Costa Rica, Ghana, India
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with reconnaissance 'failed delivery' messages to validate active email addresses
Emails with payloads downloading Silence-specific malware
Lateral movement using self-developed tools or existing binaries
Impersonation of legitimate banks via lack of SPF settings and forged emails
Indicators of Compromise: Over 170,000 reconnaissance emails sent during campaigns in Asia, Europe, and post-Soviet countries
Emails pretending to be automated replies for failed delivery
Emails with valid signature from SEVA Medical LTD
